title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has adjusted its global growth forecast for 2026 to 3.1%, indicating a milder slowdown in the world economy. This adjustment is attributed to the burgeoning impact of artificial intelligence, which is helping to mitigate the adverse effects of ongoing geopolitical conflicts. However, the IMF cautions that the resilience of economies is being tested by energy constraints and potential fiscal risks, suggesting that the current stability may not be sustainable in the long term.
